observed_problem: Goal scenarios and roadmap actions existed, but verified realized effects did not yet calibrate future scenario guidance.
prevention: Keep raw scenario assumptions immutable as user/analyst inputs.
Require at least three verified quantified outcomes per goal/lever before applying a historical calibration factor.
Expose expected-versus-realized evidence in Portal and keep Outcomes & evidence as the measurement authority.
Project calibrated effect separately from the raw assumption so provenance remains visible.
